# Voice load-test clips

These are **synthetic** short WAV tones generated for automated load testing.
They are **not** recordings of real parents or students.

- Format: mono PCM WAV, 16 kHz, ~0.4 s
- Licensing: generated in-repo for testing; no third-party audio rights
- Consent: use only with demo workbook guardians that already have consent_given_at

When longer baseline speech clips exist (see RUNNING.md accuracy/perf templates),
point the load tester at that directory with --clips-dir.
